task: Implement lattice done_prepare as a pre-DONE readiness assistant for TEST-phase story closure.
outcome: When a user runs lattice done_prepare {"storyId":"B-xxxx"}, the terminal shows DONE prepare: PASS with mergeMain, staleEvidenceRefresh, validate, doneClosure, worktreeClean, postDoneRuntimeVersionBumpRequired, localDoneReady, authorityDone=false, fullAuthorityDone=false, productionDone=false, and the exact next command lattice story_advance {"storyId":"B-xxxx","phase":"DONE"}; if blocked, it shows DONE prepare: BLOCKED, blockedAt, reason, and the next corrective command.
facts: done_prepare must prepare local DONE only and must not claim Authority DONE or production DONE.
Existing done_closure handler already projects DONE oracle rows and Authority boundary status.
Existing verification_evidence_refresh_stale supports dryRun and non-dryRun stale evidence metadata refresh; it does not expose a separate rerun-required schema.
Existing validate handler can be called in-process and writes test evidence.
Runtime version files must not be mutated by done_prepare before DONE.
Command schema entries live in packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts and handler registration lives in packages/main/src/registry.ts.
constraints: Use Lattice story/worktree lifecycle and do not modify unrelated active stories.
Do not touch senior credential files or .omx.
Do not relax REVIEW/TEST/DONE gates or evidence freshness checks.
Do not implement post-DONE version mutation inside done_prepare.
If done_prepare creates metadata changes, it must block at cleanTree with exact files rather than printing a false PASS.
